description_en: Modifies the information about multiple audio and video files at a time
name: UpdateVideoInfos

parameters.description_en:
The update content. You can modify the information about up to 20 audio and video files at a time. Separate multiple audio and video object information entries with commas (,). If you specify more than 20 objects, the update is failed and the `CountExceededMax` error is returned.
The value is a JSON character string. For more details about the parameters, see the **UpdateContent** table below.
parameters.description_zh:
更新内容。一次最多支持修改20个音/视频的信息，多个音/视频对象信息之间以英文逗号（,）分隔，一次更新超过20个将更新失败并报错`CountExceededMax`。
格式为JSON字符串，构建参数详情，参见下表**更新内容UpdateContent**。
parameters.example: [{"VideoId":"f45cf4eba5cb90233389558c39****","Title":"Alibaba Cloud VOD Video Title1"},{"VideoId":"f45cf4eba5c84233389558c36****","Title":"Alibaba Cloud VOD Video Title2"}]
